q: 成都健康管理师协会合作，按时间线理一下？
reply: Here's the timeline for Chengdu Health Manager Association partnership:
Sep 1: Xiaoyu flagged Chengdu cooperation pushed to Oct, product-launch note says "Sep onboarding"
Sep 14: Cooperation plan sent, terms acceptable, contract to be signed and mailed next day
Sep 16: Association asked for 5k deposit, agreed to pay ASAP
Sep 23: Association pushing to sign, made phone call to confirm
Sep 24: Used this partnership as leverage in BlueRun valuation renegotiation (BlueRun valued down to 72mn, aicoo stressed Chengdu deal secures growth)
Sep 25: Signed the following week, service fee negotiated down from 15 to 8 per order, first 3 months minimum 500 orders
Oct 9: Order forecast next month to hit 500
Oct 23: Association wants to push product to more communities, placing additional orders, discussing revenue share
Oct 24: Confirmed additional orders from Chengdu Association
Current state: Contract signed, service fee at 8/order with 500 minimum first 3 months, additional orders being negotiated. Want me to pull out any specific milestone details?
